install_steps: curl -L -O https://artifacts.elastic.co/downloads/beats/filebeat/filebeat-8.17.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && tar xzf filebeat-8.17.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && ln -sf $(pwd)/filebeat-8.17.0-linux-x86_64/filebeat ~/.local/bin/filebeat
note: The extracted directory contains modules.d/ and required assets, so keep it next to the symlink target. For production installs prefer the Elastic apt/yum repository (packages 'filebeat'). Bump the version in the URL for newer releases; see artifacts.elastic.co/downloads/beats/filebeat/.
